pages.lesson:
LESSON: OBLIGATIONS OF CHILDREN TO PARENTS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Muamalaat (Social Relations)
Topic 6.2: Obligations of Children to Parents

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Obligations of Children to Parents
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How do you show obedience and respect to your parents?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. demonstrate ways to obey and respect parents
2. appreciate their parents by respecting and obeying them

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: demonstrate ways to obey and respect parents

Teach
• Today’s focus: demonstrate ways to obey and respect parents.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “demonstrate ways to obey and respect parents” using a school example.
• Model B for “demonstrate ways to obey and respect parents” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "demonstrate ways to obey and respect parents" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: appreciate their parents by respecting and obeying them

Teach
• Today’s focus: appreciate their parents by respecting and obeying them.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “appreciate their parents by respecting and obeying them” using a school example.
• Model B for “appreciate their parents by respecting and obeying them” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "appreciate their parents by respecting and obeying them" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: demonstrate ways to obey and respect parents
• Model 2: appreciate their parents by respecting and obeying them

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: demonstrate ways to obey and respect parents
2. Practise: appreciate their parents by respecting and obeying them

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Obligations of Children to Parents.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do you show obedience and respect to your parents?
2. Why should children be dutiful towards their parent?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• demonstrate ways to obey and respect parents
• appreciate their parents by respecting and obeying them

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
